summary.intent: Complete phase 43 (fuse-write-durability) by verifying all review criticals are fixed, running /simplify, capturing deferred todos, shipping the PR, and addressing post-PR review feedback including codecov coverage gaps.
summary.outcome: PR #487 created and pushed with all 8 CR-01–CR-08 criticals resolved (CR-03 fully hardened across all 8 journal IPNS-key wrap sites, CR-04 deferred to post-journal mutation), /simplify applied with 3 cleanups committed, 6 deferred refactor todos captured in .planning, sync tray-bridge extracted with unit tests, Rust crate coverage wired into codecov, and 5 CodeRabbit review comments addressed (2 resolved inline threads, 3 from review body).

repo: After `gh pr create`, github-actions[bot] immediately pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the PR branch — next local push will be rejected with non-fast-forward until `git fetch` + `git rebase` is done
codecov `patch` and `desktop` flags are both `informational: true` in codecov.yml — they never block merge, the 3.84% patch coverage was non-blocking advisory

The existing `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` job already collects coverage for all crates including fuse/sdk, but only uploaded under `desktop` flag with path filter `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**` — the 40 fuse + 43 sdk tests were silently discarded
The winfsp crate cannot be compiled locally on macOS (Windows-only deps); CI `--features winfsp` check is the sole compile gate for winfsp edits
Phase 42 was already in main via squash PR #485, so the phase-43 branch commit list shows ~22 phase-42 commits that contribute zero net diff — the PR files-changed view is phase-43-only
The project enforces SSH commit signing via 1Password; commit objects fail to write if the 1Password app is locked or its signer is wedged
The Entire pre-push hook runs a checkpoint sync step before every push, adding latency to all push operations
`spawn_sync_daemon` in commands/sync.rs had no idempotency guard — calling it twice (re-auth/IPC) would spawn two daemon loops, doubling status updates and WriteParked notifications

code.finding: CR-03 residual: error fallback used `encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default()` for the child IPNS key field — storing a TEE-wrapped key where replay expects a user-ECIES-wrapped key, silently bricking replay. Fixed to warn + empty string (→ park).

CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE fallback pattern in the Windows cleanup path. Also had `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` vs `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` inconsistency at lines 148/152/886 (likely latent compile issue if winfsp CI path differed).

CR-04: inode.kind, pending_content, and queue_publish all mutated before `journal.put` — a prepare failure left partial in-memory state and an already-queued publish. Fixed by deferring all three mutations to after the journal fsync commit point.

WriteParked was not included in `is_connected()`, causing the Logout menu item to be disabled while in WriteParked state even though the user is authenticated. Fixed by adding WriteParked to the is_connected match arm.

Case-sensitive `"not found"` string match for first-publish detection — a reworded error silently flips the seq-0 branch. Mitigated with `.to_lowercase()` in cleanup; full typed-error fix deferred as todo.
`depth` variable and `MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH` constant misnamed — the value counts total nodes visited during IPNS resolution, not tree depth. Renamed to `nodes_visited` / `MAX_RESOLVE_NODES`.

sort_by_key used a full per-variant match to extract created_at_ms — duplicated twice. Extracted as `JournalOp::created_at_ms()` accessor. Also had a `plaintext_probe` test assertion that was a no-op (the string was never inserted into the entry); fixed to assert raw key bytes don't appear, verifying hex-encoding.

spawn_sync_daemon overwrote `sync_trigger` and spawned unconditionally — calling it twice left two daemon polling loops running, doubling every status update and WriteParked notification. Fixed with an idempotency guard checking if the daemon is already running.

workflow: When 1Password SSH signer fails with 'failed to fill whole buffer', quitting and relaunching the 1Password app recovers the signer — retrying without restarting will keep failing

CodeRabbit review body comments marked 'outside of diff range' are not resolvable inline threads and won't be surfaced by GraphQL reviewThreads queries — must be fetched via the review body separately
Scoping a CodeRabbit CLI review to a merge-base commit (`--base-commit`) avoids re-reviewing unchanged parent code

The `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` coverage lcov can be uploaded multiple times under different codecov flags/paths without rerunning tests — upload the same artifact file with a different flag to add coverage to new path filters

Pure tray/status mapping logic (is_connected, is_mounted etc.) is highly testable when separated from OS side effects — the pattern from tray/status.rs proved this, motivating the sync bridge extraction

friction: 1Password SSH signer failed with 'failed to fill whole buffer' on the first two commit attempts, requiring app restart — lost ~10 minutes retrying the same commit
GitHub transient network failure (port 443 timeout after 75s) blocked a push mid-session

github-actions[bot] chore(release) commit landed on the PR branch seconds after `gh pr create`, causing an immediate push rejection that required fetch + rebase — this pattern wasn't documented until it happened
winfsp edits cannot be compile-checked locally on macOS — all winfsp path changes are verified only by CI, creating a blind spot during interactive development
codecov's 3.84% patch coverage report created a false alarm — the desktop flag only sees Tauri glue, making the real Rust test suite (83 tests) invisible until the new `rust` flag was wired up
open_items: Consolidate fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods — ~150 lines of near-identical code already drifting; security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-consolidate-fuser-and-winfsp-journal-write-paths.md)

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with Option<String> uniformly + wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper — parent_ipns_key_hex uses sentinel while file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option, inconsistent within one struct (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-replace-empty-string-journal-key-sentinel-with-option.md)

Extract shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant — triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, and commands/sync.rs; a mismatch silently splits journal state between FUSE mount and sync daemon (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-extract-shared-journal-dir-and-retries-helper.md)

Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract shared cas_publish_parent helper — replay re-inlines ~70+40 lines of logic that exists in two other places; is_first_publish probe must stay outside publish_file_metadata (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-reuse-publish-file-metadata-and-cas-publish-in-replay.md)

Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault — currently re-walks vault tree from root for every replayed entry, making mount-time replay super-linear when multiple queued entries share a parent folder (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-memoize-resolve-folder-key-during-replay.md)

Replace e.to_lowercase().contains('not found') string-match in replay first-publish detection with typed Result<Option<u64>> or NotFound variant — touches PublishCoordinator and 9 call sites (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-14-replace-not-found-string-match-with-typed-error.md)
CI needs to pass the winfsp compile gate for CR-03/CR-04 edits in platform/windows/write_ops.rs — these were verified only by inspection and symmetry with the compile-tested fuser path
The 3 CodeRabbit review-body fixes (daemon idempotency, depth rename, test assertion) were committed but push was still in-flight at end of transcript — verify they landed and CI re-runs cleanly
